verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Fin's Knowledge Hub pulls content from your help center, Zendesk, Confluence, Notion and more into one source of truth. They also document website sync and a programmatic content-import-source API, so help center, docs and internal wikis are covered without re-authoring. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that past tickets or conversations are ingested as a knowledge source, independent or hands-on confirmation of ingestion quality, and detail on sync freshness.
